meta.title: Simulasi TKA Bahasa Inggris (Paket 2)
meta.catatan: Teks bacaan hanya berupa ringkasan; teks lengkap ada di situs simulasi. Field image bersifat opsional (null jika soal tidak punya gambar).

stimulus.title: The Lion and the Mouse
stimulus.summary: Seekor tikus tidak sengaja membangunkan singa. Singa melepaskannya setelah tikus berjanji akan membantu suatu hari. Saat singa terjebak jaring pemburu, tikus menggigit talinya sampai putus. Pesan: makhluk kecil pun bisa melakukan hal besar, dan semua orang kadang butuh bantuan.

stimulus.title: Effective Study Techniques
points: Use the Pomodoro Technique (25 menit belajar, 5 menit istirahat; keeps your mind fresh and focused)
Leverage Technology (apps, video lessons, online quizzes)

stimulus.title: The Great Barrier Reef
stimulus.summary: Great Barrier Reef ada di Samudra Pasifik dekat pantai timur laut Australia, panjangnya lebih dari 2.000 km. Rumah bagi ikan warna-warni, penyu, lumba-lumba, dan hiu. Bisa dinikmati dengan berenang, menyelam, atau tur kapal. Melindungi pantai dari ombak dan badai serta jadi sumber makanan dan pekerjaan.

stimulus.title: Why Teenagers Should Learn to Manage Their Money
stimulus.summary: Remaja perlu belajar mengelola uang: membuat tujuan jangka pendek (HP baru) dan jangka panjang (kuliah, buka usaha), menyusun anggaran (menabung, belanja, dana darurat), mencatat pengeluaran, dan memahami beda menabung dan investasi.

table.caption: Table 1. How do students manage their money?
rows: Students who often borrow from friends

stimulus.title: The False Lion King
stimulus.summary: Hera adalah singa kuat yang dihormati. Shero bersuara cempreng dan suka pura-pura sekuat Hera. Saat hyena bikin onar, raungan Hera menakutkan mereka, sedangkan raungan Shero ditertawakan dan Shero jatuh ke tanah. Hera bilang Shero punya kelebihan sendiri karena membuat semua senang. Shero jadi pelawak kerajaan dan mereka memimpin bersama.

soal.question: Which option best summarizes the story?

options.text:
Beginning: A lion was walking through the jungle.
Problem: The mouse got lost and couldn't find food.
Solution: The lion gave food to the mouse.
Lesson: Always be generous to those in need.

Beginning: A mouse accidentally disturbed a sleeping lion.
Problem: The lion was caught in a hunter’s net.
Solution: The mouse chewed through the net and set the lion free.
Lesson: Even the smallest creature can be a great help.

Beginning: The lion and mouse were best friends.
Problem: The lion got hurt in a fight.
Solution: The mouse helped him find water.
Lesson: Friendship is built on adventure.

Beginning: A mouse was building a home near a tree.
Problem: A storm destroyed the tree and trapped the lion.
Solution: The mouse called for help from the jungle.
Lesson: Teamwork solves big problems.

Beginning: A lion was hungry and searching for food.
Problem: He couldn’t catch any prey.
Solution: The mouse helped him find food.
Lesson: Hunger teaches humility.

soal.pembahasan: Hanya B yang awal, masalah, solusi, dan pesannya sesuai alur cerita.

soal.question: Which of the following statements best conveys the message of the story?
soal.instruction: There is more than one answer. Click on every correct answer!

options.text: We should never wake up a sleeping animal
Even the small and weak can help the strong
It’s always good to ask for help when we need it
Lions are dangerous animals and should be avoided
Never trust anyone who plays with your hair

soal.pembahasan: Kalimat terakhir teks: makhluk kecil bisa melakukan hal besar (B) dan kita semua kadang butuh bantuan (C).

soal.question: Why did the lion trust the mouse and decide to let him go instead of eating him?

options.text: The lion was too tired to eat the mouse
The mouse told the lion he might help him one day
The lion was felling happy to see the mouse
The lion heard someone coming and got scared
The mouse promised to bring food for the lion

soal.pembahasan: Tikus berjanji: "If you let me go, I promise I'll help you one day."

soal.question: As you read the part where the lion let the mouse go, which of the following endings do you anticipate?
soal.instruction: There is more than one answer, click on every correct answer!

options.text: The mouse forgets about the lion and never helps him
The lion gets into trouble and no one helps him
The lion becomes angry at all small animals
The mouse spreads the lion's kindnes to other animals
The mouse becomes the lion’s loyal assistant

soal.pembahasan: Setelah dilepaskan, wajar menduga tikus akan membalas kebaikan singa. A, B, dan C berlawanan dengan arah cerita.

soal.question: Which of the following sentences from the story help you understand the lion’s character?
soal.instruction: There is more than one answer. Click on every correct answer!

options.text: “The lion always took his afternoon nap under the shade of a big tree in the bushes.”
“He caught the mouse and questioned him for interrupting his nap.”
“The lion was amused at the mouse’s words and decided to spare his life.”
“With his sharp teeth, the mouse nibbled through the net.”
“The lion thanked the mouse immensely for his help.”

soal.pembahasan: B menunjukkan singa galak, C baik hati, E tahu berterima kasih. A hanya kebiasaan, D tentang tikus.

soal.question: Based on the information given, we can keep our mind focused and fresh by ….

options.text: knowing your learning style
using Pomodoro Technique
using online quizzes apps
by reviewing materials
by creating mind maps

soal.pembahasan: Poin 4 infografis: "This keeps your mind fresh and focused."

soal.question: Based on the infographic, determine whether each study technique listed on the left is categorized as Time Management or Self Management.
soal.pembahasan: Pomodoro dan jadwal belajar mengatur waktu; sabar dan tekun soal mengatur diri sendiri.

soal.question: From the options provided, choose the sequence that best reflects the information in the infographic “Effective Study Techniques”.

options.text: Set your goal → Watch lessons videos → Sleep well → Have group chat with friends → Eat nutritious meal
Plan study time → Join a study group → Take long breaks → Write a to do list → Write important points
Know your learning style → Find a quiet area → Set a timetable → Use less gadgets → Be patient and persistent
Know your study style → Plan your study time → Practice and repeat → Take a break → Watch lessons videos
Take notes → Join a study groups → Use different medias → Play music you like → Have good meal while studying

soal.pembahasan: Semua langkah di D ada di infografis. C memuat "Use less gadgets", padahal infografis menyarankan memakai teknologi (poin 8).

soal.question: Which of the following statements best reflect the author’s purpose in writing the text?
soal.instruction: There is more than one correct answer. Click on every correct answer!

options.text: To help students find fun strategies to play after studying
To offer students guidance on how to learn more efficiently
To encourage students to use simple habits to improve their learning
To explain why studying tips is difficult for most students
To show students that they can manage their time and focus better

soal.pembahasan: Infografis berisi panduan dan kebiasaan sederhana untuk belajar, termasuk mengatur waktu dan fokus. A dan D tidak dibahas.

soal.question: If you are preparing for an important exam and want to improve your study routine, which of the following techniques do you think can be implemented effectively in your personal study time?
soal.instruction: There is more than one correct answer. Click on every correct answer!

options.text: Only study when you are in a group discussion with others
Use technology during all study sessions in or outside class
Use the Pomodoro Technique to structure your study and break time
Practice and repeat study material regularly to retain information
Create a quiet and comfortable study space to improve focus

soal.pembahasan: Sesuai poin 4, 6, dan 3. A dan B terlalu mutlak ("only", "all").

soal.question: Which of the following descriptions are mentioned clearly in the text?
soal.instruction: There are more than one correct answer. Click on every correct answer.

options.text: The reef was built by local communities over hundreds of years
The reef is located in the Pacific Ocean near Australia
The reef can help protect the coast from big waves
The reef is home to sea turtles and dolphins
The reef has more than 10,000 coral islands

soal.pembahasan: B, C, D tertulis langsung di teks. A dan E tidak disebut (teks hanya bilang "many small coral islands").

soal.question: The author mentioned “It feels like a different world under the sea”. What does the phrase "a different world under the sea" most likely mean?

options.text: A safe place that has bright reef
A peaceful place where people can live under water
A colorful place that looks the same as the land
A shining reef that is quiet
A calm place that looks beautiful and unique

soal.pembahasan: Paragrafnya menggambarkan pemandangan bawah laut yang indah dan tidak ada di darat.

soal.question: Which of the following best represents the main idea implied by the text?

options.text: The reef is useful for fishing and shipping
The reef is large, but not important to people
The reef is a natural treasure that must be cared for
The reef is only for scientists and researchers to explore
The reef is a protected area that should be closed to visitors

soal.pembahasan: Teks menekankan terumbu ini indah sekaligus penting ("Without the reef, the ocean would not be the same").

soal.question: Which detail would best encourage people to visit the Great Barrier Reef?

options.text: Visitors can see an Australian national park
Visitors can stay in hotels around the reef
Visitors can get there by boat or short flights
Visitors can protect the coral and the animals
Visitors can see the coral by diving or swimming

soal.pembahasan: Teks: "People can see this beauty by swimming, diving, or joining a boat tour."

soal.question: Which parts of the text best support the idea that the Great Barrier Reef is both beautiful and important?
soal.instruction: There is more than one correct answer. Click on every correct answer!

options.text: The reef helps protect the coast from big waves
It is home to sea turtles, dolphins, and colorful fish
The coral reefs grow best in cold, deep water
Some areas of the reef are damaged by starfish and warm water
The reef was discovered by sailors in the 1800s

soal.pembahasan: A menunjukkan terumbu ini penting, B menunjukkan keindahan dan perannya sebagai habitat. C, D, E tidak ada di teks.

soal.question: Based on the text, choose the activity that best fits the description

statements.text: Saving to buy a new phone

soal.pembahasan: Teks menyebut langsung: HP baru = jangka pendek, kuliah dan buka usaha = jangka panjang.

soal.question: According to the text, which of the following actions support smart money management for students?
soal.instruction: There is more than one correct answer. Click on every correct answer!

options.text: Tracking daily expenses using a notebook or app
Spending more money than the monthly budget allows
Setting financial goals for the short and long term
Borrowing money whenever there is not enough left
Dividing money into saving, spending, and emergency funds

soal.pembahasan: A, C, E disarankan di teks. B dan D kebiasaan buruk.

soal.question: Who is most likely to be the target audience of this text?
soal.instruction: There is more than one correct answer. Click on every correct answer!

options.text: Teenagers who are learning to manage their money
Parents looking for tips on how to control their children’s spending
Students who want to plan for their financial future
High school readers who need to understand saving and budgeting
Bankers and financial experts

soal.pembahasan: Teks ditujukan ke remaja dan pelajar, bukan orang tua atau ahli keuangan.

soal.question: Which information would make the text more informative about student spending habits?

options.text: A paragraph about the history of financial education in schools
A table showing common monthly high school students expenses
A graph comparing saving habits between teenagers and adults
A chart listing popular entertainment choices among students
A paragraph about students' experiences in managing budget

soal.pembahasan: Data pengeluaran bulanan pelajar paling langsung menjelaskan spending habits.

soal.question: Which of the following statements are supported by clear data or facts in the text and table?
soal.instruction: There is more than one correct answer. Click on every correct answer.

options.text: 45% of students save money regularly
Tracking expenses can help understand spending habits
Most students do not care about money at all
Saving 10% of allowance is a good practice
Spending on fun activities is always better than saving

soal.pembahasan: A dan D ada di tabel, B ada di paragraf keempat. C dan E tidak didukung data.

soal.question: Which statement provides the most accurate chronological summary of the story's main events?

options.text:
Shero falls into the dirt.
The hyenas cause trouble at the river.
Hera tells Shero that he is funny.
Shero copies Hera’s roar.
Shero becomes the kingdom's funny helper.

Hera is a strong lion king.
Shero likes to pretend to be strong.
The hyenas cause trouble near the river.
Hera scares the hyenas, but Shero makes them laugh.
Shero learns that making others happy is special.

Hera and Shero are both strong leaders.
The hyenas come to help the lions.
Shero tells funny stories to the hyenas.
Hera is angry with Shero.
The lions and hyenas become friends.

Shero is a strong lion king.
Hera is jealous of Shero.
The hyenas attack the lions.
Shero defeats the hyenas.
Shero becomes the new king.

Shero wants to be king and fights Hera.
The hyenas help Shero.
Hera leaves the kingdom.
Shero becomes king.
Hera returns to forgive Shero.

soal.pembahasan: Isi dan urutan B sesuai cerita. Urutan A acak; C, D, E isinya salah.

soal.question: What can we learn from the story of Hera and Shero?
soal.instruction: There is more than one correct answer. Click for every correct answer!

options.text: Everyone has something special to give, even if they are not the leader
Being funny and making others smile is just as important as being strong
Good friends will support you and help you see your real strengths
Working together is better when people use their different talents
Trying your best to help others is more important than always being perfect

soal.pembahasan: Akhir cerita: Shero punya "his own special gift" (A), "both power and fun are important" (B), dan mereka memimpin bersama dengan bakat masing-masing (D).

soal.question: The hyenas laugh so much when Shero tries to roar like Hera because ....

options.text: Shero tries to roar in a serious way and surprises the hyenas
Shero’s roar is funny, which the hyenas think he is joking
Hera tells a joke about Shero to make the hyenas laugh
Shero is acting like Hera, and it's absolutely brilliant
Shero trips and falls when trying to show his strength

soal.pembahasan: Suara Shero "high and silly", jadi hyena menertawakannya. E terjadi belakangan, bukan saat meraung.

soal.question: If in the beginning of the story, Shero is a strong lion with a loud roar, just like Hera. What would happened in the end of the story?
soal.instruction: There is more than one correct answer. Click for every correct answer!

options.text: Shero and Hera would both scare the hyenas away together
Shero would become the king, and Hera would leave the savannah
Shero would get respect from the other animals for his strength
The hyenas would still laugh at Shero because he is funny
Shero would try to take Hera’s place as the only lion king

soal.pembahasan: Kalau Shero sekuat Hera, raungannya ikut menakuti hyena dan dia dihormati. B dan E tidak berdasar, D bertentangan dengan pengandaian.

soal.question: Shero is clumsy and funny, this is shown when he ....
soal.instruction: There is more than one correct answer. Click for every correct answer!

options.text: scares the hyenas away with his loud and powerful roar
makes the other animals smile by pretending to be a great king
tries to roar like Hera, but his voice is small and makes the hyenas laugh
walks with Hera to confront the hyenas, acting as if he is an important king too
tells the hyenas that he is as mighty as King Hera, even though no one believes him

soal.pembahasan: B, C, E membuat yang lain tertawa. A itu Hera; D hanya ikut pergi, belum menunjukkan sisi lucunya.
